summary: Extract transport-free sidebar projection and planning into fractal-sidebar

schema.detail: No database or wire schema change; the core consumes existing arrangement schema bodies.

compatibility.detail: Rust consumers must use fractal-sidebar model, projection and plan modules instead of fractal-ui-model::sidebar and supply transport-free ArrangementInput records. Version-1 projection, move validation and rollups are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or host activation.

manual.detail: No deployment or data migration required.

recovery.detail: Reverting the crate extraction requires no persisted-state migration.
